dreamteamer.title: Perspective
dreamteamer.description: Reads a person's past work — git history, coding-agent sessions, tickets, mail, Drive files and notes — and builds the operating model it runs on: activities, projects, decisions, workflows, vocabulary, goals, findings and the assumptions under them, ending in proposals for what your workspace should track. Every record is found, never authored. Start with /run-retrospective.
